text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — ACME GPU joint announcement next Wed. We need an agreed embargo window + explicit rollback / unpublish flow for the marketplace. Proposing we lock driver/CUDA/ROCm pins by EOD Thu so partner comms can be finalized.

Alex Chen: Proposed pins (initial):
```
nvidia-driver: 535.86
cuda: 12.2.1
rocm: 5.6.3
```

Mira Patel: +1 on locking by Thu. Can we run a small marketplace canary the Friday before launch? :eyes:

Samir Kapoor: We should also include a quick smoke matrix for kernel versions (RHEL8/9, Ubuntu22/24). If kernel ABI fails we need a clear fallback.

Natalie Ortiz: Legal requests a 48-hour embargo from code freeze to public announcement. Means pins must be stable 2 days before scheduled press.

Theo (NVIDIA PM): We can sign off on 535.86 but need confirmation on the exact distro kernels tested. I'll ask QA to run ABI checks on RHEL8-6 and RHEL9-5.

Alex Chen: Ok — rollback playbook draft (short):
1) Block new marketplace installs (unpublish/change flag)
2) Promote previous pinned bundle (last-known-good)
3) Trigger infra routing to fallback model variant for affected customers
4) Ship driver micro-patch and coordinate partner release notes

Alex Chen: Example unpublish command for marketplace (ops runbook):
```
# unpublish package
marketplacectl publish set --package gpu-driver-535 --state hidden --reason "rollback"
```

Samir Kapoor: For steps 2-3 we need automation. Suggest a small script `promote_last_good.sh` that takes bundle id + env. Can do a canary to 5% before full rollout.

Mira Patel: Ops: can we get `deploy-bot` to emit an alert when canary error rate > 2%? We want a fast, observable trigger for rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary monitor created for bundle gpu-driver-535. Threshold: 2% error rate. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Natalie Ortiz: Also: joint press coordination — partners require a shared timeline doc 24 hours before release. Please add a single line in the partner PR with "embargo: YYYY-MM-DD hh:MM UTC" once pins are final.

Theo (NVIDIA PM): Will share kernel test matrix by EOD Wed. Also ask partner PM to confirm they can hold their public announcement if we trigger rollback.

Alex Chen: Action items: 
- Alex: finalize pins and update partner PR by Thu EOD (owner)
- Mira: schedule marketplace canary and set 5% gate (due Fri)
- Samir: owner of promote/unpublish automation + script (due Thu)
- Natalia: confirm legal embargo window and add note to partner PR (due Thu)
- Theo: share kernel test matrix (due Wed EOD)

Samir Kapoor: I'll start the automation repo CL today and tag @Mira for the canary config.

Mira Patel: Thanks. Once the pins are in the PR I'll run the canary job and post results here. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Great — if anything blocks, ping me and @Theo. We want to avoid a messy hotfix on launch day.

Theo (NVIDIA PM): Thanks all — will coordinate partner-side readiness and confirm rollback SLA.

Alex Chen: Closing thread for now; will post updated pins when final.
